summary: Solo hiker stranded on a narrow ledge at 13,400 ft in the Kirk Couloir between Kit Carson and Challenger peaks activated Garmin inReach; multi-agency overnight rescue completed Oct 7; patient treated and released
responding_agency: Custer County SAR (lead), Saguache County SAR, Saguache County OEM, Chaffee County SAR South, AVSAR, CSAR, Canon Helitack, DFPC, Flight For Life Colorado, CO Army National Guard, Colorado Hoist Rescue Team
notes: Stranded on narrow ledge in mixed rock/snow/ice; patient care transferred to Flight For Life; treated and released from hospital | Run-131 merge: MV Journal narrative (opened) adds the solo hiker activated a Garmin inReach on Sunday afternoon, was cliffed out on a narrow ledge at 13,400 ft in the Kirk Couloir between Kit Carson and Challenger peaks unable to ascend or descend; multi-agency overnight response delegated to CCSAR (Saguache SAR, Saguache OEM, CCSAR-South, AVSAR, CSAR, Canon Helitack, DFPC, FFL Colorado, CO Army National Guard, CO Hoist Rescue Team); patient transferred to Flight For Life, treated at an area hospital and released; completed Monday Oct 7. | Run-560 merge: Miner Oct-17-2024 print edition (opened) corroborates the Kirk Couloir rescue; also notes in-story mentions of the Aug-22-2024 Crestone Peak fall fatality and the July-2022 Luis Corkern Kirk Couloir fatality. [merge run-605: UN article corroborates same incident]
